summary: Enphase Energy filed an 8-K disclosing a Tax Credit Transfer Agreement to sell up to $150 million of Section 45X advanced manufacturing production tax credits to a leading financial institution for up to $139.5 million, payable in four installments through 2027. The agreement involves standard conditions precedent, covenants, indemnification, and termination provisions. This transaction monetizes tax credits generated from eligible component production in the US. As a non-deal special situation, it falls under 'Other' categories like tax credit sales. Watch for payment milestones and the company's ability to generate sufficient credits to fulfill the agreement.
